prompt: what skills do you have available?

assertions.name: lists_many_skills
assertions.description: Response mentions at least 10 distinct skill names

assertions.name: groups_by_category
assertions.description: Response organizes skills into at least 2 named groups or categories

assertions.name: includes_invocation_guidance
assertions.description: Response explains how to invoke a skill (mentions slash commands or /skill-name pattern)

assertions.name: mentions_vercel_family
assertions.description: Response acknowledges the vercel:* family of skills (doesn't silently omit them)
